comparison.objective: Make a deli slicer safe, release its carriage, and place the carriage on a cleaning tray, versus set and lock a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1850 requires ordered knob operations, carriage translation/lift, and avoidance of a blade zone; the candidate requires coupled tool countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1850 requires zero gauge opening before motion, release-knob travel, safe removal, tray placement, and clearance; the candidate requires retained opening angle across cycles.
comparison.reason: Safety-conditioned disassembly and carriage handling test a different ability from locking an adjustment.
